blocks.text: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ. וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ:

blocks.text: וַתִּתֶּן־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת־יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְאֶת־יוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם:

וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ. וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶךָ בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶׁךָ. יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד־מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹפַע

וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָל חָי וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם: וְאֶת מוּסְפֵי יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְיוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶךָ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְתָּ עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ כָּאָמוּר:
(אם שבת:)
(וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ:)

וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיְיָ פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כַּמְדֻבָּר שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָיִל וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ וְיַיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ וּשְׁנֵי־שְׂעִירִים לְכַפֵּר. וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ. וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ. וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיְיָ:
בק״ק פפד״מ ובנותי׳ אומרים.
וּשְׂעִיר לְכַפֵּר מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ וּשְׂעִיר לְחַטָּאת וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:
(אם שבת:)

(יִשְׂמְחוּ בְמַלְכוּתְךָ שׁוֹמְרֵי שַׁבָּת וְקוֹרְאֵי עֹנֶג עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי. כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וּבִשְׁבִיעִי רָצִיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ חֶמְדַּת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָאתָ זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:)
בעלינו פותחים חלון. בשל״א שם חלקנו סוגרים חלון, ובואנחנו כורעים פותחים חלון.

עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים. הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד. אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ. כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ, וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד:

אַתָּה הָרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד: הֵן לַיְיָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַשָּׁמַיִם וּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם הָאָרֶץ וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ: כִּי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הוּא אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשָּׂא פָנִים וְלֹא יִקַּח שֹׁחַד: כִּי שֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵינוּ: יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֱיֵה עִם פִּיפִיּוֹת שְׁלוּחֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. הָעוֹמְדִים לְבַקֵּשׁ תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים מִלְּפָנֶיךָ עַל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. הוֹרֵם מַה שֶׁיֹּאמֵרוּ. הֲבִינֵם מַה שֶׁיְדַבֵּרוּ. הֲשִׁיבֵם מַה שֶׁיִּשְׁאָלוּ. וְיַדְּעֵם דֶּרֶךְ יְפָאֲרוּךָ: בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן. בֶּרֶךְ לְךָ יִכְרָעוּן. עַמְּךָ בְּפִיהֶם יְבֹרָכוּן. וּמִבִּרְכוֹת פִּיךָ כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרָכוּן: עַמְּךָ לְפָנֶיךָ יַעֲבִירוּן. וְהֵם בְּתוֹכוֹ יַעֲבוֹרוּן: עֵינֵי עַמְּךָ בָּם תְּלוּיוֹת. וְעֵינֵיהֶם לְךָ מְיַחֲלוֹת: נִגָּשִׁים מוּל אֲרוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּאֵימָה. לְשַׁכֵּךְ כַּעַס

וְחֵמָה. וְעַמְּךָ מְסַבְּבִים אוֹתָם כַּחוֹמָה. וְאַתָּה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם תַּשְׁגִּיחַ אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמָם: עַיִן נוֹשְׂאִים לְךָ לַשָּׁמַיִם. לֵב שׁוֹפְכִים נָכְחֲךָ כַמָּיִם. וְאַתָּה תִּשְׁמַע מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם: שֶׁלֹּא יִכָּשְׁלוּ בִּלְשׁוֹנָם. וְלֹא יִנָּקְשׁוּ בִּשְׁנוֹנָם. וְלֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּמִשְׁעֲנָם. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ בִם שָׁאוּם. וְאַל יֹאמַר פִּיהֶם דָּבָר שֶׁלֹּא כִרְצוֹנֶךָ: כִּי חֲנוּנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ הֵמָּה חֲנוּנִים. וּמְרֻחָמֶיךָ הֵמָּה מְרֻחָמִים: כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת אֲשֶׁר תָּחוֹן יוּחָן. וְאֶת אֲשֶׁר תְּרַחֵם יְרֻחָם: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן. וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אֲרַחֵם:
בפפד״מ, מיץ ורוב קהלות אין אומרים.
וְנֶאֱמַר אַל יֵבֹשׁוּ בִי קֹוֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת. אַל יִכָּלְמוּ בִי מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
פותחים חלון.

אוֹחִילָה לָאֵל. אֲחַלֶּה פָנָיו. אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִמֶּנּוּ. מַעֲנֵה לָשׁוֹן: אֲשֶׁר בִּקְהַל עַם. אָשִׁירָה עֻזּוֹ. אַבִּיעָה רְנָנוֹת. בְּעַד מִפְעָלָיו: לְאָדָם מַעַרְכֵי לֵב. וּמֵיְיָ מַעֲנֵה לָשׁוֹן: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:
סוגרים חלון.

עַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה־לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזֶּךָ לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי. וְכָל־בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל־בֶּרֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל־לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּלוּ. וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ. וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם אֶת־עֹל מַלְכוּתֶךָ. וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא וּלְעוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד:
אם שבת ווירד דיא אונטענשטעהענדע תפלה געבעטעט.
מיוסד ע״ס א״ב מרובע.
קה״ג.

אֲנַסְּכָה מַלְכִּי. לְפָנָיו בְּהִתְהַלְּכִי. אֲסַפֵּרוּ בְמָלְכִּי. יֶאֱזוֹר עֹז וְיִמְלֹךְ: אֱלִיל בְּהַשְׁלִיכִי. לִפְנֵי בֹּא יוֹם מַלְכִּי. אִישׁ מַלְאָכִי יִשְׁלַח וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ: בְּבוֹאוֹ לַהֲלוֹךְ. כָּחַשׁ חָנֵף מִמְּלוֹךְ. בֵּית גֵּאִים בַּל יִמְלֹךְ. יֻסַּח לְבַל יִמְלֹךְ: בְּתוֹכִי יַהֲלוֹךְ. בְּהוֹפִיעוֹ לִמְלֹךְ. בְּמַלְכוּתוֹ אֶמְלֹךְ. וְאָז יִמְלֹךְ: גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכוֹת. בִּמְגוּרוֹ מַמְלָכוֹת. גּוֹיִם וּמַמְלָכוֹת. יָהוֹם וְהוּא יִמְלֹךְ: גִּלְיוֹן הֲלִיכוֹת. וְסֵפֶר תַּהֲלוּכוֹת. גַּל הַיּוֹם לִפְנוֹת. חוֹכֵן לְמָלוֹךְ:
אם שבת.
קהל

אֲהַלְלָה אֱלֹהַי. אָשִׁירָה עֻזּוֹ. אֲסַפְּרָה כְבוֹדוֹ. אֲעַטְּרֶנּוּ מְלוּכָה: אֲשַׂגֵּב לְפוֹעֵל. אֲשֶׁר שָׂח וּפָעַל. אֲנַוֵּהוּ. כִּי לוֹ יָאֲתָה מְלוּכָה: בְּעוֹז נֶצַח אֶשְׁנֶּה. כִּי צְבָאוֹ אֲנִי. וְלִי נָאֶה שֵׂיחַ גֹּדֶל הַמְּלוּכָה: בְּקָהָל אֲבַשֵּׂר. בְּרַב עָם אֲדַבֵּר. לְמִי שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עֹז. וּלְמִי הַמְּלוּכָה: גֹּשׁוּ גּוֹיִם. וּבֹאוּ מַמְלָכוֹת. רְאוּ מַה נֶּהְדָּר. בְּצַח הַמְּלוּכָה: גַּדְּלוּהוּ אִתִּי. וּנְרוֹמְמֶנְהוּ יַחְדָּו. וְאַל תִּתְגָּאוּ. בְּכוֹר הַמְּלוּכָה: דְּרָכִים בְּעֵת נֶעֶשְׂתָה מְצוּלָה. הִתְבּוֹנְנוּ יַחַד. לְמִי נִזְרְקָה מְלוּכָה: דָּרַךְ סוּס בַּיָּם. כְּנֶגֶד שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב. וּמַה יוֹעִיל גֶּבֶר עִם מְלוּכָה: הֶאֱזִינוּ רוֹזְנִים. אָז וְרָגְזוּ. הִבִּיטוּ וְחַתּוּ. וּמָאֲסוּ מְלוּכָה: הַגִּידוּ כֹחוֹ. לְאֻמִּים וְדִבֵּרוּ. לָזֶה יִכָּתֵב שֵׁם הַמְּלוּכָה: וְנִכְלָם רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם

דּוֹרֶכֶת נְסִיכוֹת. בְּחָזוֹן קוֹל בְּכוֹת. דִּבְּרָה אָנֹכִי בַּמַּלְכוֹת. וּמִי יוּכַל לִמְלֹךְ: דְּכָאִי רוּחַ נְמִיכוֹת. מְחַפְּשֵׂי בְּיוֹם דִּין זְכוֹת. הַשֵּׂה בַעַל מַלְכוּת. עַד צוּר יִמְלֹךְ: הֲלוֹךְ מְהַלֵּךְ. חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָלַךְ. הֲדוֹר עַד הָמֶלֶךְ. בְּעֻזּוֹ לִמְלֹךְ: הֶבֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ. עַל מָה מָלַךְ. הֲלֹא כְּמוֹ נִמְלַךְ. כִּי אַיִן לִמְלֹךְ: וּמִלִּפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מָלַךְ. חַי מִלְּפָנִים מָלַךְ. וְעַד תֵּבֵל כָּל מֶלֶךְ. הוּא לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ: וּמָה יָעוֹז מֶלֶךְ. בְּעֹז מִשְׁפַּט מֶלֶךְ. וְכַעֲבוֹר סוּפָה כְּהַלַךְ. יַחֲלֹף מִמְּלוֹךְ: זָךְ דִּין בְּעֶרְכּוֹ. יָאָה דַרְכּוֹ. זָדִים בְּדָרְכוֹ. נָקָם יַעַט וְיִמְלֹךְ: זָר

blocks.text: וְאָבַד. כִּי נִשְׁבַּע חַי. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה: וַיִּלְעַג כְּכָל דּוֹר. כִּי לֹא לָמוֹ. מִי נִלְחַם בַּיָּם. וְעָשָׂה מְלוּכָה: זָד עַל אֲדוֹנָיו. עֶבֶד יָשַׁב נֹב. בְּזֹאת רָגְזוּ אָרֶץ. בִּשְׂאֵת עֶבֶד מְלוּכָה: זֶרַע בְּרוּכִים. הֶחֱרִימוּ אֲרוּרִים. כִּי נָתְנוּ קוֹל. לְאַדִּיר בִּמְלוּכָה: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבָשָׁן. עוֹרְרוּ מִלְחָמוֹת. בְּלִי לָתֵת דֶּרֶךְ. לְצִבְאוֹת מְלוּכָה: חֵילָם נִשְׁמָד. וְאַרְצָם חִלְּקוּהָ. וּמֹעַל זַרְעָם. נִגְלָה מְלוּכָה: טִפְּשׁוּ בְנֵי כְנַעַן. כִּי נָכְרִים הֵם. בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי שֵׁם. זֶרַע מְלוּכָה: טְרָפָם בִּן נוּן. עַד פְּנֵה אָרֶץ. לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית. אֲרוֹן הַמְּלוּכָה: יוֹשְׁבֵי חֲרֹשֶׁת. אָז הֻקְשָׁה לַחַץ. עוֹרְרוּ כְלִי בֶצַע. אַפְסֵי מְלוּכָה: יָהּ נִלְחַם בָּם. צְבָא כְלִי בֶצַע. כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ שְׂרָר. וְלָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה: כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן. אַשּׁוּר גָּדַל. וְחֵרֵף אוֹיֵב.

זָד כְּשִׁכְּרוֹ. יִתֵּן עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ. וְכַס בְּהַמְלִיכוֹ. עַל כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ: חִדְּשׁוּ מְלוּכָה. כְּדָת וּכְהֲלָכָה. חֹמֶר מַמְלָכָה. בְּמִישׁוֹר יִמְלֹךְ: חֻבַּשׁ אֲרוּכָה. וְאָךְ יוֹם מְנוּכָה. חֲתֻלָּה לְמַפֵּכָה. עַל כַּעַס יִמְלֹךְ: טוּחוּ מַלְכִיוֹת. עוֹבְדֵי מַשְׂכִּיוֹת. טִמְּאוּ חַמֵּי שְׂכִיוֹת. בְּגֵאוּת לִמְלֹךְ: טוּרֵי זְכוּיוֹת. וּשְׁאָג קוֹל בְּכִיוֹת. טְבַע עֹל רְכֻיוֹת. יֶפֶן בָּם יִמְלֹךְ: יֶהֶב מַשְׁלִיכִים. עַלֵּיו בְּנֵי מְלָכִים. יוֹם זֶה לוֹ מְחַכִּים. בּוֹ יָבֹא לִמְלֹךְ: יַעֲבְרוּ מִתְהַלְּכִים. לְפָנָיו כְּמַלְאָכִים. יַחַד מַמְלִיכִים. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: כִּתִּים בְּכִתּוֹ. אִיִּים בְּהַכּוֹתוֹ. כֹּס מַמְלַכְתּוֹ.

כְּבִיר הַמְּלוּכָה: כְּלִיל אֵשׁ הֲמָמָם. בִּגְלַל שַׁמּוּרִים. וְאָז יָדְעוּ כֹל. כִּי לָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה: לִשְׁחֹת כָּרַע בֵּל. כְּחָשְׁבוֹ עֲלוֹת לַשַּׁחַק. וְסָר מִנּוֹ לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ. וְרָד הַמְּלוּכָה: לְבָנוֹ חוּשַׁב. וְנֶתַח אַל הִכִּיר. לַמָּרִים וּמַשְׁפִּיל. הַשָּׁלִיט מְלוּכָה: מִגְרָה צֹאן לְטֶבַח. וְנִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִילוֹת. בִּלְבוּשׁ צָעִיר. רָם הַמְּלוּכָה: מְכוּרֵי בְּלֹא הוֹן. פְּדוּיֵי בְּלֹא כֶסֶף. סֻלּוּ לְטֹהֲרָה כַּפַּיִם. לְב הַמְּלוּכָה: נִמְכְּרוּ יוֹנִים. לִבְנֵי יְוָנִים. וּרְחוֹקִים מֵעַל גְּבוּל מְלוּכָה: נָאֲרוּ בְרִית וְדָת. וְהִמְרִידוּ עַם בָּאֵל. וּמְגוּרִים בְּלֹא כֹחַ. מִכֹּהֲנֵי מְלוּכָה: שְׂעִיר הֶחֱנִיף. לְהוֹרֵהוּ בְּצֵידוֹ. וַיִּירַשׁ בְּקוֹל בְּכִי. חֶרֶב וּמְלוּכָה: חזן שָׂגַב חֶלְקוֹ. הָיוֹת גְּבִיר לְאָחִיו. וְעוֹד תִּסּוֹב. לִישׁוּרוּן מְלוּכָה:

יִפְנוּ וְיִמְלֹךְ: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ. וְקָדוֹשׁ הֲלִיכָתוֹ. כִּגְמָרוֹ מְלַאכְתּוֹ. לְעֵין כֹּל יִמְלֹךְ: לְכָל גֵּאֶה יַפִּיל. וְהַר וָגֶבַע יַשְׁפִּיל. לְכָל אוּם יַאֲפִיל. וּבְאוֹר זְרוֹעַ יִמְלֹךְ: לְרֹאִי יַקְפִּיל. וְחָדָשִׁים יַכְפִּיל. לְיוֹם זֶה פּוּר הִפִּיל. מִצִּיּוֹן לִמְלֹךְ: מַטֵּה גוֹיִם הָמוֹן גֵּאִים. מֵעֲדֵי מִתְגָּאִים. גֵּאֶה בְּגֵאוֹ לִמְלֹךְ: מַלְכוּ דְגוּיִם. נִטְּלוּ סְגוּיִם. מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם. עַת יֵאָתֵא לִמְלֹךְ: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים יֵאָסְפוּ מְעַמִּים. נָשְׂאוּ מַשְׁאֵי עַמִּים. אֶל מְקוֹמָם יִמְלֹךְ: נְגוֹן נְעִימִים. לְמוּלָם מַנְעִימִים. נְשָׂאָם מֵעֲמָמִים. עֲלֵיהֶם לִמְלֹךְ: סְבוֹת אֱלִילִים. כִּיון

כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ בְּצִיּוֹן. שֵׁם נוֹרָאוֹת. כָּאָז תְּצַלִּיתָה. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה: חזן עוֹרֵר וְתַקֵּן. מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. וְכוֹנֵן כִּסְאָךְ. בְּקִרְיַת מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ. יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. הַר צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב: פְּנֵי מְאוֹר לְבָנָה. וְחַמָּה תַחְפִּיר. וְיֵבוֹשׁוּ עוֹבְדֵימוֹ. בְּשֵׂאתְךָ מְלוּכָה: חזן פָּאֵר עִיר יוֹפִי. לְכָה נְחֶמְדָה. וְנִגְלָה לְנֶגְדֵּנוּ כְּבוֹד מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ. וְחָפְרָה הַלְּבָנָה וּבוֹשָׁה הַחַמָּה כִּי מָלַךְ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בְּהַר צִיּוֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלַם וְנֶגֶד זְקֵנָיו כָּבוֹד:

blocks.text: גִּלּוּלִים. סָחוֹב כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים. יֻשְׁלְכוּ בְּלִי לִמְלֹךְ: סוֹד אֵל אֵלִים. הָבוּ בְּנֵי אֵלִים. שְׂאוּ זִמְרָה וְהִלּוּלִים. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: עוֹזֵז יָד בְּהִנָּשְׂאוֹ. לְהָרִים נְשִׂיאוֹ. עֲמָסוֹ בְּנָשְׂאוֹ. עֹז וְיִמְלֹךְ: עַל רוּם מַשָּׂאוֹ. וִיהֻהוּ בְּנָשְׂאוֹ. עַל הוֹד כִּסְאוֹ. יָשַׁב וְיִמְלֹךְ: פּוּר תְּפוֹרֵר אָרֶץ. בְּכִלָּיוֹן וָחָרֶץ. פַּח בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ. יִרְגְּזוּ וְיִמְלֹךְ: פַּחַד שׁוֹפְרוֹת עָרִץ. יְשַׁלֵּשׁ וּבָם יָרוּץ. פָּאֵר מִכְּנַף הָאָרֶץ. יַעֲלוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: צְבִי מִקֶּדֶם יַעַל. וְאֶדֶר מֻשְׁעָל. עוֹל מִשְּׁמֵי מַעַל. יְרַנְּנוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: צִבְאוֹת כָּל פֹּעַל. לְצַלְעָם יִרְמִי תַעַל. צְפִירַת פְּאֵר לְהַעַל. חֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלֹךְ: קְצִיעִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ. אֲחֶרֶת יֻשְׁלְכוּ.

צִבְאוֹת גְּאוּלֵי צֹעַן. שׁוֹרְרוּ בְּלֵיל חָג. וְהוּא לַיְלָה נִשְׁמָר. לְסַחֵף מְלוּכָה: חזן צַעֲדוּ בְּמֵי שׁוֹעַל. צִבְאוֹ כָּרוּת שְׁבִיל. אָוָה יָמְשְׁעוּ וִיקַבְּלוּ מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְיָ מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ: וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: קִמְטוּ שַׁעֲרֵי זְבוּל. בֵּית עוֹלָמִים. כִּי מְכִינֵימוֹ. שִׁבְּרוּהוּ מְלוּכָה: חזן קָדוֹשׁ יָבֹא בָם. לְעוֹלָמִים. וְאָז יִשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ. בְּחַדְּשׁוֹ מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה:

קוֹל יִתְּנוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ. לָאָדוֹן כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: קְרוּאִים יִמְלוֹכוּ. וְאַחֲרָיו יַהֲלוֹכוּ. קוֹמְמִיּוּת יֵלֵכוּ. וּבְרֹאשָׁם יִמְלֹךְ: רָז הַמִּכְמָן. לְיוֹם זֶה מְזֻמָּן. רָשׁוּם לְמוֹעֵד וּזְמַן. וּבוֹ נוֹקֵם יִמְלֹךְ: רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן. בְּבֹאוֹ מִתֵּימָן. רוּחַ יַסְעִיר כְּתֵימָן. בְּגִלְעָד יִמְלֹךְ: שִׁנְאָן עֲלִיּוֹת. וְסוֹד פְּלִיאוֹת (נ״א פְּלִילִיּוֹת). שִׁיר מְתֻלָּלִיּוֹת. יִפְצְחוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: שְׁאוֹת תַּחְתִּיּוֹת. וְהוֹד אוֹתִיּוֹת. שְׁאוֹן הֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת. יָרִיעוּ כִּי יִמְלֹךְ: תִּכּוֹן כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ. שְׁמוֹ לִפְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ. תָּאָרְכוּ כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. בְּמָלְכוֹ יִמְלֹךְ: חזן תּוֹקֵף מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ. וְעַד מְבוֹא שֶׁמֶשׁ. תַּמָּה בָּרָה כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. יְרוֹמֵם וְיִמְלֹךְ:

רַכָּה עֲדִינָה. שָׁקְדָה מֵאַלְמוֹן. כִּי אָרַךְ לָהּ. קֵץ הַמְּלוּכָה: חזן רִיבוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים. שְׂאוּ אֶדֶר מְאוֹרִים. וְשָׁרֵת עַל אָרוֹן. הוֹד הַמְּלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה: שׂוֹא שְׂנָא אֵל. וְהוּא עַל לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ. בַּקֵּשׁ אֱמֶת וָאֵין. וְרָחֲקָה מְלוּכָה: חזן שַׁדַּי הָסֵר אוֹן מִצְּבָאֶיךָ. וְיָרִיעוּ לְךָ. תְּרוּעַת מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ: תַּחֲנוּן גֵּאוּת. תִּתְאוֹרֵר עֹז. לְבַל יִשְׁתָּרֵר. זָר בִּמְלוּכָה:

כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וְנֶאֱמַר לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ: וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כִּי לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה וּמוֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט: וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה: וְעַל יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגֹאֲלוֹ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי רִאשׁוֹן וַאֲנִי אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדַי אֵין אֱלֹהִים: וְנֶאֱמַר וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

blocks.text: חזן תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל. כִּי יִנָּעֵר רָשָׁע. וְשָׂם צֶדֶק לְרַגְלָיו. וְיִצְנוֹף מְלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט: תָּקוּם גּוֹיִם. תּוֹכִיחַ לְאֻמִּים. תִּשְׁבּוֹר מַטֵּה רָשָׁע. מוֹשֵׁל הַמְּלוּכָה: חזן תַּחֲלִיף אֱלִילִים. תַּשְׂגֵּב לְבַדֶּךָ. הִקָּרֵא נֶצַח. יִחוּד בַּמְּלוּכָה: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. מְלוֹךְ עַל כָּל־הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בִּכְבוֹדֶךָ וְהִנָּשֵׂא עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ בִּיקָרֶךָ וְהוֹפַע בַּהֲדַר גְּאוֹן עֻזֶּךָ עַל כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל אַרְצֶךָ. וְיֵדַע כָּל־פָּעוּל כִּי אַתָּה פְעַלְתּוֹ וְיָבִין כָּל־יְצוּר כִּי אַתָּה יְצַרְתּוֹ וְיֹאמַר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נְשָׁמָה בְּאַפּוֹ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה: (אם שבת. אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ) קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ. (אם שבת. וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ.) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְךָ בֶאֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת וּדְבָרְךָ (מַלְכֵּנוּ) אֱמֶת וְקַיָּם לָעַד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן:
ותוקעין — ובשבת אין תוקעין.
תְּקִיעָה: שְׁבָרִים: תְּרוּעָה: תְּקִיעָה:
יש קהלות חלוק נוהגים בשבת רק היום ולא ארשת, ויש שאומרים היום חזן רק ארשת. ויש שאומרים שניהם חזן רק הש״ץ חוזר, ויש שהש״ץ חוזר היום ואינו חוזר ארשת, ויש שהש״ץ חוזר שניהם וכן נוהגין ק״ק פפד״מ.

blocks.text: קו״ח

הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם. הַיּוֹם יַעֲמִיד בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. כָּל יְצוּרֵי עוֹלָמִים. אִם כְּבָנִים. אִם כַּעֲבָדִים. אִם כְּבָנִים רַחֲמֵנוּ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. וְאִם כַּעֲבָדִים עֵינֵינוּ לְךָ תְלוּיוֹת. עַד שֶׁתְּחָנֵּנוּ וְתוֹצִיא כָאוֹר מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ אָיוֹם קָדוֹשׁ:
ואומרים ארשת והש״ץ חוזר, ויש קהלות שהש״ץ חוזר בשבת, ויש שאין הש״ץ חוזר.
קו״ח
אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא. מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל (אם שבת. זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָתֵנוּ וּתְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן סֵדֶר מַלְכֻיּוֹתֵינוּ:

Thou hast chosen us from all peoples, loved us and found delight in us and exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us through Thy commandments, and brought us near, O our King, to Thy service and proclaimed Thy great and holy Name unto us.

Thou hast given us, O Lord, our God, in love this day (of the Sabbath and this day) of remembrance, a day (of remembrance) of Teruah (in love) for a sacred convocation, a reminder of the exodus from Egypt.

Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes

of all the living. Bring near our dispersed ones from among the nations and collect our scattered ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion, Thy city, in mirth and to Jerusalem the House of Thy sanctuary, in eternal joy. There we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations, the regular offerings according to their order and the additional offerings according to their rule. And the additional offerings of this day of memorial we will prepare and offer up before Thee in love according to the commandment of Thy will as Thou hast written for us in Thy Torah through Moses Thy servant from Thy glorious mouth, saying:
On the Sabbath

On the Sabbath day two flawless lambs in their first year and two tenths of flour mixed with oil as a meal offering, and its drink offering. The Sabbath whole-offering on its Sabbath day in addition to the regular whole-offering and its drink offering.

In the seventh month on the first day of the month you shall have a sacred assembly. You may not do any form of work, a day of Teruah shall it be for you. You shall prepare a whole-offering of sweet savour to the Lord, one young bullock, one ram, seven flawless lambs in their first year. Their meal-offering and their drink offering shall be as has been said, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram and one tenth for each lamb, wine according to its drink-offering and two he-goats in order to atone and the two regular offerings according to their rule. Besides the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering and its meal-offering and the drink offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.
On the Sabbath

Let those who observe the Sabbath and call it a delight, the people who sanctify the seventh day, rejoice in Thy kingdom. Let them all be satisfied and find delight out of Thine abundance. Thou hast favoured the seventh day and sanctified it, the most precious of days hast Thou called it, a reminder of the work of creation.
The Holy Ark is opened.

It is right for us to praise the Master of everything, and ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, that He has not made us like the nations of the lands and has not placed us like the families of the earth, that He has not made our portion like theirs nor our destiny like that of all their multitude. We kneel, bow down and give thanks before the Supreme King of kings, the Holy One blessed be He, who has extended the heavens and founded the earth and His glorious dwelling is in Heaven above and His mighty presence in the loftiest heights. He is our God, there is no other. In truth He is our King, there is none besides Him. As it is written in His Torah: ‘And you shall know this day and repeat it in your heart that the Lord is God in the heavens above and that on earth below there is no other.’

You were taught to perceive that the Lord is God with none besides Him. You shall know this day and repeat it in your heart that the Lord is God in the heavens above and that on earth below there is no other. Hear, O Israel!, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One. Behold to the Lord your God heaven and the highest heavens belong, the earth and all that is on it. For the Lord your God is the supreme God and the supreme Lord, the great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, who neither respects rank nor accepts bribes. For I call upon the Name of the Lord, ascribe greatness to our God. May the Name of the Lord be blessed from now until eternity.
The Holy Ark is closed.

Our God and God of our fathers, be with the mouths of the emissaries of Thy people, the House of Israel, who rise to entreat in prayer and supplication before Thee on behalf of Thy people the House of Israel. Teach them what they should say, make them understand what they should speak, grant them what they request and instruct them how they should glorify Thee. Let them walk in the light of Thy countenance, bend the knee before Thee, bless Thy people through their mouths and by the blessings of Thy mouth may they all be blessed. Thy people do they lead past Thee and they pass by in their midst. The eyes of Thy people hang upon them and their eyes hope for Thee. They approach the

Holy Ark in awe to soften anger and wrath; Thy people surround them like a wall and Thou dost watch from heaven to show them mercy. They lift up their eyes to Thee in heaven, they pour out their hearts before Thee like water and Thou dost hear them from heaven, lest they stumble with their tongue, be confused in their repetition or be shamed in their confidence, lest their congregation be disgraced by them and their mouth say aught that is not according to Thy will. For those favoured by Thee, O Lord our God, are indeed favoured and those who are pitied by Thee are truly pitied, as we know well, O Lord our God, that he whom Thou dost favour is favoured and he whom Thou hast pitied, is pitied. As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘I will favour him whom I favour and pity him whom I pity’.
And it was said: ‘Let those who trust in Thee, O Lord God of Hosts, not be shamed through me, let those who seek Thee, O God of Israel, not be disgraced through me’.

I pray to God, I entreat His countenance, I beg Him for pleasant speech. In the assembly of people I sing to His might, I utter exultations because of His deeds. Reflections of the heart belong to man but pleasant speech is from the Lord. O Lord, open my lips that my mouth may proclaim Thy fame. Let the words of my mouth find favour and the meditation of my heart before Thee, O Lord, my rock and my redeemer.

Therefore we hope for Thee, O Lord our God, that we may soon behold the glory of Thy strength, that abominations may disappear from the earth and idols be entirely cut down, so that the world may be remedied through the Kingdom of the Almighty and all children of man may call upon Thy Name, and all the wicked of the earth may turn to Thee. All inhabitants of the world will perceive and know that to Thee every knee should bow and every tongue swear. Before Thee, O Lord our God, will they kneel and fall and to the glory of Thy Name will they grant honour and they will all accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom. And Thou shalt soon reign over them for ever and ever. For Thine is the Kingdom and for all eternity shalt Thou reign in glory.
On the Sabbath the prayer below the line is said:

I pay homage to my King, when I walk before Him, I praise His royal might, how He girds Himself with strength and reigns. When I cast away vanity, before the arrival of my king (the anointed) He will send the herald of my salvation (Elijah), and then will He reign. On his approach, falsehood will cease to reign, the house of the proud will not reign, it will be destroyed so that it can no more reign. He will walk in my midst, when he appears in order to reign, through his kingdom will I reign and then will He reign. The owners of kingdoms, when He shatters kingdoms, both nations and kingdoms will He confound and then reign. The scroll of the world’s paths, the book of the ways of life,
On the Sabbath.

I praise my God, sing of His might, tell of His honour, I crown Him with a kingdom. I will exalt the Creator who spoke and created, I will glorify Him for the kingdom becomes Him. His might shall I ever repeat for I am of His host, and for me it is fitting to speak of the grandeur of the kingdom. In assembly do I proclaim, before a multitude of people do I announce whose is loftiness and might and whose is the kingdom. Approach, O nations, and come, O kingdoms, behold how glorious He is with the diadem of the kingdom. Call Him great with me, together let us exalt Him, do not behave proudly with the crown of the kingdom. When paths were laid through the depths of the sea, they all understood to whom was granted the kingdom. His horse walked through the sea against six hundred chariots of war, what did might avail man against the kingdom. Princes heard and then trembled, they looked around in dread and abdicated their kingdom. Peoples told of His power and said: to Him shall be written the name of the kingdom. The first people (Amalek)

open this day for the merit of those who wait for Him to reign. She with the princely tread, when the sound of (Esau’s) tears implored, said: ‘the kingdom is mine, who else can then reign?’ The lowly and humble who seek for merit on the day of judgment, are bowed by the yoke of the kingdom until the Rock shall reign. There is wandering here and there on a way of five hundred years until in glory is He crowned and in His might shall He reign. As to Bel set on a throne, over what does he reign? Through whom was he crowned that he has hastened to reign? Before any king ruled, the Everlasting was king; and when all kings cease, He alone will reign. What might has Molech before the might of the King’s judgment? When a whirlwind sweeps by him, he ceases to reign. The Pure One arranges justice and holds fast to His way, when He treads down the proud, He wears vengeance
On Sabbath.

to fight fought and perished, for the Lord had sworn by the throne of the kingdom. Amalek earned shame in every generation since he had not learned who fought at the sea and was clothed in the kingdom. The slave, who lived in the south, presumed against his master, whereupon the earth trembled when the slave took the kingdom. The seed of the blessed (Israel) destroyed the accursed since they raised their voice against Him who is glorious in kingdom. Heshbon and Bashan stirred up war for they would not grant passage to the hosts of the kingdom. Their army was annihilated, their land was divided and their seed was deprived of a kingdom. The Canaanites were foolish for they had been strangers on the soil of the sons of Shem, the seed of the kingdom. The son of Nun slew them until he cleared the land before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the kingdom. The man of Harosheth was hard in oppression, there helped him without pay those far from the kingdom. The Lord fought against them with a Host without payment, may the rest perish likewise and to God be the kingdom. Like the cedar on Lebanon did Assyria grow great and blasphemed: ‘In my might I will bring down the kingdom’. When the ray of fire destroyed them in the night of vigil, then all could perceive

and reigns. When He casts down the garland of the proud, He will give power to His appointed king, when He crowns the pure over all will He reign. He renews the realm according to faith and law that the royal offspring may in equity reign. He soothes in healing after the long time of trouble, He will bandage the wound at the time when He will reign. The oppression of the kingdoms, worshippers of images, they have defiled the most precious sights in their pride to reign. To the purity of merits, the roar of the sound of weeping of those cast into the raging floods the Lord will turn, and over them will He reign. Upon Him the royal princes (Israel) lay their burden, on this day do they wait for Him that on it He will come to reign. They pass while walking before Him like angels, paying homage in unison: ‘The Lord will reign’. When He crushes the Kittim, when He smites the islands, the throne of His kingdom will be established and
On Sabbath.

that to God was the kingdom. Bel sank into ruin when he planned to rise to heaven, human reason left him and he descended from the kingdom. When restored to his place, he acknowledged God’s power, to Him who raises and lowers, he delivered the kingdom. Like sheep to the slaughter was it (Israel) to be driven, then was God’s work accomplished by the youngest tribe (Benjamin from whom Esther was descended) through the power of the kingdom. You who were sold without a price (Israel) will be redeemed without silver, prepare the way for Him who turns like water the heart of the kingdom. The doves (Israel) were sold to the Greeks and they banished them from the frontier of the kingdom. Covenant and law were broken, they caused the people to rebel against God, then powerless were they crushed by the priests of the kingdom. The hairy one flattered his father with his venison and through the sound of weeping inherited sword and kingdom. Exalted will be the smooth one, becoming master to his brothers and once again will return to Yeshurun the kingdom.

He will reign. The glory of His kingdom, the holiness of His course, will be apparent to all when He completes His work and will reign. He will fold up the skies and unfold new skies on the day appointed by lot for Him from Zion to reign. The nations falter, the proud clamour, the arrogant fall when the exalted One comes to reign. Then those compared to the fish of the sea (Israel) shall rule, their multitude will be raised up when the King of nations comes forth to reign. The noblest of the peoples shall be gathered from among the peoples to bring the smallest of peoples to their place where He will reign. They will chant pleasant songs before them whom He has lifted up from among the peoples so that over them He may reign. The idols of Sikkut, the abominations
On the Sabbath.

As it is written in Thy Torah: He was King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel. Make for Thyself in Zion an awe-inspiring name, prosper it as of old with the throne of the kingdom. Arouse and revive the delight of the whole earth (Jerusalem) and establish Thy throne in the city of the kingdom. As it is written in Thy holy words: a beautiful branch, the delight of the whole earth, the mountain of Zion, the stronghold of the North, the city of the great King. The light of the moon and of the sun wilt Thou cause to blush and those who worship them will be put to shame when Thou dost lift up the kingdom. Glorify the city of beauty, that it may be bright as the sun and reveal in front of us the glory of the kingdom. As it is written through Thy prophet: and the moon shall blush and the sun be ashamed, for the Lord of Hosts rules on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and in front of His elders there is glory.

of Kiyun, are dragged along as if slain, they are cast down so that they may not reign. O assembly of the Supreme God, do homage, you sons of the powerful (forefathers), offer singing and praise to the Lord for He will reign. When He lifts His strong hand to raise up His prince and exalts those He has carried, He will be powerful and reign. When He raises His hand above the high heavens, on the splendour of His throne He will be seated and reign. The earth is shaken by destruction and ruin, in which dwellers on earth will be ensnared when He will rage and reign. Three times will He make sound the dread of powerful Shofar blasts and them will He favour, they will cause glory to rise from the end of the earth, for He will reign. Beauty from the earth will ascend and glory from the sea, exultation from the heavens above, they will all rejoice when He will reign. To the hosts of all creatures He brings remedy for their defects, aloud will they praise His glory: Behold in justice does He reign. The princes
On Sabbath.

The hosts redeemed from Egypt sang on the night of the feast, this is the night preserved for the devastation of a kingdom; they stepped through the waters of the sea, they looked with a spirit of insight to the place where they were to be planted and receive the kingdom. As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘Thou wilt bring them and plant them upon the mount of Thine inheritance, the site for Thy dwelling which Thou hast made, O Lord, the sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established’. And it was said: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’. Destroyed are the gates of the temple, the House of eternity, for there has ceased from among them the Kingdom. The Holy One will return to them for ever; then will they raise their heads again when He renews the Kingdom. As it is written: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, mighty and strong, the Lord, mighty in war’. And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’.

who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign. Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign. The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign. The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign. The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign. The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign. Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God’s realm will He reign. He who from sunrise to sunset sustains the flawless people that is bright as the sun (Israel), will exalt and reign.

The voluptuous one (Babel) sprawled at ease, she did not fear widowhood, for far from her was the end of the kingdom. Struggle, deliverers, take the royal gown from Edom and adorn the Lord with the splendour of the Kingdom. As it was written through Thy prophet: Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s. God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom. Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy Torah: And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel. The Lord, his God, is with him, and the royal Teruah is within him. Gird Thyself in loftiness, surround Thyself with strength, so that no stranger may rule over the Kingdom.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever.’ And it was said: ‘And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel, the Lord His God is with him and the royal Teruah within him.’ And it was said: ‘And He became King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel’. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘For dominion is the Lord’s and He is ruler over nations’. And it was said: ‘The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.’ And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in war. Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: ‘Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God’. And it was said: ‘Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s. And it was said: ‘And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One’. And in Thy Torah it is written saying: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One’.

blocks.text: On Sabbath.

The world will be firm when the wicked is shaken off, the Lord will set justice beneath Him and put on the crown of the Kingdom. As it is written in Thy holy words: The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter. Thou wilt take vengeance on nations, Thou wilt rebuke peoples, Thou wilt break the staff of evil, ruling over the Kingdom. Thou wilt make idols disappear, Thou alone wilt be exalted, Thou wilt be invoked for ever, unique in the Kingdom. As it is written through Thy prophet: The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His name One. And it is written in Thy Torah: Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.

Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all. (Our God and God of our fathers, take pleasure in our rest.) Sanctify us through Thy commandments and grant our portion in Thy Torah, satisfy us with Thy goodness and gladden us with Thy help (and grant us, O Lord our God, in love and favour, Thy holy Sabbath as a portion so that Israel, who sanctifies Thy Name, may rest on it) and purify our heart to serve Thee in truth for Thou, O Lord, art truth and Thy word is truth and endures for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King over the whole earth, who sanctifies (the Sabbath and) Israel and the Day of Remembrance.
The Shofar is blown (but not on the Sabbath)

On this day the world was completed. On this day He brings to judgment all the world’s creatures, either like children or like slaves. If like children, then have mercy upon us as a father has mercy on children. If like slaves, then our eyes are lifted to Thee until Thou wilt be gracious to us and make our verdict shine forth like light, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One.

May the utterance of our lips be pleasing before Thee, O lofty and exalted God, who understands and listens, pays heed and hearkens to the sound of (the memory of) our Teruah. Mayest Thou accept with compassion and favour the order of our praises of Thy Kingdom.
